title: K$_{4}$Cu$_{8}$Ge$_{3}$S$_{12}$ Structure
comments:
Only 2/3 of the K II (48f) sites are occupied. 
 (Zhang, 2018) does not give the structure for K$_{4}$Cu$_{8}$Ge$_{3}$S$_{12}$.  This is taken from their published data filed with the CCDC and the CIF.  This structure can have various inclusions, which can be found in CCDC entries 1844864-1844871.
